notes: Exit 2 denies the elicitation; stderr not shown anywhere. permission_mode is NOT delivered to this event -- neither upstream example carries it, and the common-fields table makes the per-event example authoritative ('Not all events receive this field. Check the JSON example in each hook event section'). That reading is correct for permission_mode and for any UNCONDITIONAL field, but it does NOT generalise: an example depicts one call, so a CONDITIONAL field is absent from it whether or not the event delivers it, and inferring 'never delivered' from that silence is a false negative. Those live in conditional_input_fields instead -- see PreToolUse.json, where agent_id is delivered yet unshowable. Upstream documents TWO input shapes: the form-mode example recorded here, and a url-mode example identical except that it carries 'url' (e.g. https://auth.example.com/login) in place of requested_schema. The docs also list an optional elicitation_id for this event, but no Elicitation example carries it -- it appears only in the ElicitationResult example -- so it is deliberately absent here rather than invented.
